sys_util: have Poller return token on POLLHUP If POLLHUP is filtered out of the returned tokens, the caller of Poller::poll will likely just put the same (token, fd) in the next call to poll which will return instantly. This degrades into a busy poll loop without the chance for the caller to change the poll list. Instead, this change changes the filter to return tokens on POLLHUP so that the caller will hopefully notice the FD associated with the token has been hungup and will close it. CHROMIUM: x86: Use LAHF/SAHF instead of PUSHF/POPF with clang to save/restore FLAGS By default clang emits PUSHF/POPF instructions to save and restore the FLAGS register. With these instructions all FLAGS bits are saved and restored, including the Interrupt enable flag (IF) and the trap flag (TF), which is problematic in the kernel. Modern x86 CPUs support the LAHF/SAHF instructions, which only save/restore a subset of register bits (OF, SF, ZF, AF, PF, CF). Tell clang to use LAHF/SAHF instead of PUSHF/POPF. This is a temporary workaround, the implementation of an actual fix (in clang) is in progress. power: automating power measurements during autotests w/ Sweetberry Add Sweetberry to power autotest automation. I used a "call client test from server test" approach. From power_MeasurementWrapper, the Sweetberry starts to measure power on the DUT, then the client test will run on DUT, then Sweetberry stops measurement. Then power_MeasurementWrapper trims the Sweetberry log generated in the overhead time of the client test, and uploads Sweetberry data generated during actual client test to power dashboard. All assumptions are stated in the control file.
